title: Workshop on Theory of Neuromorphic Computing
summary: A workshop titled 'Theory of Neuromorphic Computing' is scheduled for 9 June 2026 at the University of Liverpool. Organized by John Sylvester and David Purser, it focuses on theoretical foundations including algorithms and computational complexity rather than hardware deployment. The event aims to discuss rigorous models capturing energy-related resources like spikes in neuromorphic systems.
tldr: A free workshop on neuromorphic computing theory is scheduled for 9 June 2026 at the University of Liverpool, focusing on algorithmic foundations and computational complexity.
